standard_prerequisites.use: The proof checks the total-complex differential against the differential rule in Definition definition-tensor-product.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 354-363): for differential graded R-algebras (A, d) and (B, d) with underlying cochain complexes A^bullet and B^bullet, there is an equality of cochain complexes of R-modules (A tensor_R B)^bullet = Tot(A^bullet tensor_R B^bullet).

Verification (proof lines 365-371): the differential of the total complex acts on the summand A^p tensor_R B^q as d_1^(p,q) + (-1)^p d_2^(p,q); this is exactly the rule d(a tensor b) = d(a) tensor b + (-1)^m a tensor d(b), m = deg(a), by which Definition definition-tensor-product endows A tensor_R B with its differential, with deg(a) = p on that summand.
proof_roadmap: Recall the total complex differential on the double complex with summands A^p tensor_R B^q.
Match it term by term with the differential rule defining the tensor product dga.
difficulty_reason: Definitional-identity lemma (statement 354-363, proof 365-371): the underlying cochain complex of the tensor product dga is the total complex of the tensor product of the underlying complexes - the proof displays the total-complex differential d_1 + (-1)^p d_2 on A^p tensor B^q and checks it coincides with the defining rule of Definition definition-tensor-product; the comparison is complete as stated, no step omitted. H3: one-formula comparison.
